headline: Gary Lava recommends Mesoblast as a buy at $2.10, citing FDA-approved product generating cash and a large Phase 3 back pain trial underway
reasoning: Gary highlights that Mesoblast now has its FDA-approved stem cell product generating approximately $36M in quarterly revenue, potentially approaching $120M annually, meaning the company no longer needs to tap markets for capital. The company has enrolled 300 patients in a Phase 3 back pain trial which could open a massive addressable market for anyone requiring back surgery. Additional products for knees and hips are in development. The stock has pulled back from $2.78 to $2.10, which Gary views as an attractive entry point despite high volatility.
quote: Two things is that the company is actually making money, so it doesn't have to go and tap the market to raise money. And secondly is that it's got its latest sort of back trial there. So the 300 patients have already sort of done dusted. They're all sort of signed up, even though it's a 12-month trial... that sort of stem cell market, particularly that's a back trial as well. So anyone having back surgery, you look at what the ground cells basically for the transplant markets... anyone having any back surgery in the future potentially could be having a stem cell there... Down at $2.10 here, I think it's definitely a buy.
